note: A value that satisfies one bound may still fail another. Finite bounds do not imply practical enumerability, native-proof fit, or financial correctness.

sourceIntake.role: UTF-8 .moriarty source and decoded AST JSON before signing
sourceIntake.basis: experiments/moriarty-developer-mock/src/language/core.ts LIMITS and safeJsonValue; language Text uses UTF-8 bytes, not JavaScript string length

signingEnvelope.role: actual public canonical signing envelope; do not raise these limits in this profile
signingEnvelope.representabilityRule: If a candidate signed object exceeds these actual envelope bounds, reject as unrepresentable. Do not embed FloorDiv trees in the envelope.
signingEnvelope.roundtripObligation: Maximum-depth expressions are tested inside the elaborated program object. The signing envelope binds programHash, state, action, effects, authority summary, and versions. A nested AST that cannot fit depth 16 is not a signing object.

contradictionDisposition.rejectedDraft: raise signing envelope depth from 16 to 40
contradictionDisposition.decision: keep actual claims.ts depth 16, bytes 65536, nodes 8192; hash the program; source/AST intake may use depth 40

contradictionDisposition.decision: source and canonical keys use [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}; external labels including loan:demo are Text values

contradictionDisposition.decision: language Text is 256 UTF-8 bytes; signing envelope strings keep the actual 4096 UTF-8 and 4096 JS-length dual bound
